description: Best/median/spread credit-union deposit APY by product, term, and state, with per-CU peer ranking. Pass the MCP field `product` using one exact underscore value: savings, cd, share_certificate, money_market, ira_cd, ira, or share_savings. The MCP server translates it to REST `product_category`; do not send `product_category`, `mma`, or `money-market` to this tool. Deposits quote APY (no APR); CDs/share certificates include term. Current + recent data; history is retention-bounded.

limit.description: Top N credit unions to rank (default 10, clamp 1..50).

metric.description: Deposits rank by APY, highest first. No APR.

product.description: MCP field for the deposit product category. Use an exact enum value such as `money_market`; do not use REST field name `product_category`, `mma`, or `money-market`. Omit for all deposit types.

state.description: 2-letter US state code; omit for nationwide.

term_months.description: For CD/share_certificate/ira_cd: filter to a specific term (savings_term_months).

name: get_deposit_benchmarks

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the underlying rate data. This is when the rates were last scraped from lender sites, not when this call ran.

benchmark_balance.description: Deposit balance in dollars the rates are quoted at. Null means no balance tier was applied, so tiered rates may not be comparable.

apy.description: Highest annual percentage yield in percent (4.1 = 4.10% APY). This is a yield the member earns, not a borrowing cost.

lender.description: Credit union publishing the highest APY.

term_months.description: Term in months of the best offer.

count.description: Number of rows returned in `table`, capped by the caller's limit.

market.description: Distribution of APYs across the market for this product, for context around `best`.

count.description: Number of offers behind the market statistics. This can exceed total_credit_unions when one credit union publishes several tiers.

max_apy.description: Highest APY in percent published, matching `best.apy` when the table is not filtered further.

median_apy.description: Median APY in percent; the right comparison for whether an offer is good.

min_apy.description: Lowest APY in percent published in this market.

note.description: Data caveats for this response, including that APY is shown rather than APR and that history is retention-bounded.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

table.description: Ranked deposit offers, highest APY first.

apy.description: Annual percentage yield in percent, compounding included. Do not describe it as an APR.

best.description: True on the single highest-APY row in this table.

bps_below_leader.description: How far this offer sits below the top APY, in basis points (10 = 0.10 percentage points). 0 marks the leader.

position.description: Rank in this table, 1 = highest APY.

savings_subtype.description: Subtype of savings product, such as a money-market or youth account. Null when the lender did not distinguish.

term_months.description: Term in months for this certificate. Null for products without a fixed term.
Certificate term in months these rows are scoped to. Null for non-term products like savings.

total_credit_unions.description: Number of credit unions publishing this deposit product in scope — larger than `count` when the table is truncated.
